meta.title: How the Future Together
meta.description: How every field of society has changed since 1900 and could change by 2100, drawn together: sourced history for the past, branching scenarios for the future.

intro.lede: From the past to the future, we draw together how every field of society has changed and could change. The past is told through sourced history, the future through imagination that branches with the conditions. Every story is a **piece** someone added.
load.errorBody: Build the site with npm run dev in the repository, then open it. (It needs data/futures.json.)

picture.dome: The whole city lives under a clear dome, sealed off from the air outside.
picture.sea-high: The sea has swallowed the lower city; people live on upper floors and bridges.
picture.sea-mid: Seawater reaches the coastal roads, and the seawall has become the city's new edge.
picture.heat-high: Summer lasts more than five months, and the streets are empty at midday.
picture.heat-low: The seasons still keep their shape.
picture.smog-high: The sky is a permanent yellow-grey, dim enough to look straight at the sun.
picture.smog-low: The air is clear enough to see the far ridgelines.
picture.green-high: Forest climbs the walls and rooftops until the city is one large garden.
picture.green-low: Almost no green is left, and the remaining trees are kept behind fences.
picture.solar-high: Solar panels cover every roof, and wind turbines turn on every hill.
picture.tech-high: Autonomous aircraft cross the sky, and maglev trains glide along elevated tracks.
picture.tech-low: Technology has stopped at roughly today's level.
picture.density-high: Dense high-rises crowd out the sky.
picture.density-low: The city is low and spread thin.
picture.decay-high: More windows go dark, and vines grow over abandoned buildings.
picture.divide-high: The gleaming district behind the high wall and the worn neighbourhoods outside live in different times.
picture.divide-low: Living standards differ little from one neighbourhood to the next.
picture.community-high: Every street has a shared garden and a common table, and big decisions are made together.
picture.community-low: People live behind their own closed doors.
picture.neutral: Leaning no particular way, the city drifts a little further from today.

road.here: The picture you are looking at
write.title: Write a piece
write.desc: Write one scene of social change, either history that happened or a future that could. Write in any language. Pieces are reviewed together on GitHub, merged, and then appear for everyone.
f.author: GitHub username
f.title: Title
f.storyPh: Show one concrete scene from that future. Who is there, where, doing what?
f.fill: Fill in from the current conditions
f.whenHint: The piece appears when every checked condition matches. Narrower ranges make a more specific future.
f.sceneHint: How much this piece changes the picture when it appears. 0 means no change.
f.translations: Also write it in other languages (optional)
f.translationsHint: If you write in more than one language, add translations too. Leave them empty and other contributors can translate later.
f.preview: Preview it in the picture above
status.pristine: Fill in your username, title and story and the format is checked here as you type.
status.ok: Format check passed. Ready to send.
status.matches: This piece appears under the current conditions.
status.noMatch: This piece doesn't appear under the current conditions. Move the conditions into its ranges.
status.idTaken: The id "{id}" is already used by another piece. Choose another name.
send.hint: ‘Send to GitHub’ opens a GitHub page with the file already filled in. Press **Propose changes**, then **Create pull request**, and you're done. You need a GitHub account.
opinion.title: [Comment] {title}
people.title: Who drew it
people.note: {people} {people|person has|people have} drawn {pieces} future pieces. The more pieces there are, the more the picture reflects many people's imagination.
people.seed: First seed (pieces the project planted to start)
langs.title: Translation progress
langs.desc: A piece can be written in just one language. Anyone can add translations, and every translation lets more people read the same future.
atlas.title: Map of the imagined
atlas.desc: Keeping the other conditions as they are and changing only these two, each cell shows how many pieces appear. **?** cells are futures no one has drawn yet. Click a cell to go there.
how.title: How this site grows
how.1: **Explore** Move between past and future and see how each field changes.
how.2: **Write** When a scene is missing, write a future piece and send it to GitHub.
how.3: **Refine together** Others comment, edit and translate it before it's merged.
how.4: **Redraw** Merged pieces appear on the site automatically.
footer.note: These pictures are not predictions. They are imagination we write together. Every future piece and drawing rule is public on GitHub.
err.shape: The whole file must be an object shaped like { "author": ..., "lang": ..., "futures": [...] }.
err.unknownTop: Unknown field "{key}". Only author, lang and futures are allowed.
err.author: author must be your GitHub username (letters, numbers, hyphens).
err.lang: lang must be the code of the language the piece was first written in: {langs}
err.futures: futures must contain at least one future piece.
err.item: Each future piece must be an object.
err.id: id must use lowercase letters, numbers and hyphens, 60 characters at most. e.g. "sea-wall-cities"
err.textShape: title and story must be text, or written per language like { "ko": "...", "en": "..." }.
err.textOriginal: title and story must include the original language ({lang}).
err.textPair: {lang}: write both the title and the story in this language.
err.title: {lang}: the title must be 2–40 characters.
err.story: {lang}: the story must be 20–400 characters. A concrete scene from that future works best.
err.when: Choose at least one condition (when) under which this future appears.
err.year: The year range must be [start, end] between {min} and {max}.
err.unknownCond: Unknown condition "{key}" in when. Available conditions: {keys}
err.range: when.{key} must be [min, max] between 0 and 100.
err.sceneKey: Unknown field "{key}" in scene. Available fields: {keys}
err.sceneValue: scene.{key} must be a number between -0.5 and 0.5.
err.sources: Sources may only contain URLs starting with http(s).
err.dupInFile: The id "{id}" is used twice in one file.
err.dupGlobal: The id "{id}" is already used in {file}. Choose another id.
err.json: JSON syntax error: {message}. Check for a missing comma or quote.
err.issueNoJson: The issue has no "Future piece JSON". Paste the JSON made with "Write a future piece" on the website.
controls.pastNote: The past has already happened, so the conditions can't change it. Move to 2030 or later and the conditions shape the future.

chron.title: Chronicle by field
chron.desc: See at a glance how {n} fields of society changed from 1900 and could change up to 2100. Past cells show what actually happened; future cells show what unfolds under the conditions you chose. Press **+** in an empty cell to write a piece for it.
f.historyHint: A history piece must be about something that actually happened, with at least one source link.
f.domainsHint: 1–3; the first is the main field
err.historyWhen: A history piece's when may only contain the year: the past is the same whatever the conditions.
err.historyYear: A history piece's years must be [start, end] between {min} and {max}.
err.historySources: Add at least one source (sources) to a history piece.
